The hedge fund held 84,082 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.23 million, down from 101,801 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Family Management Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $927.68 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.30% or $0.57 $188.74.
